fields.headline: Possible measles exposure at three Marston County locations
fields.summary: A resident with measles visited the places below while infectious. Measles spreads through the air and can remain in a room for up to two hours after an infected person leaves.

exposures.window: Oct 17 and Oct 18, 7:30 a.m. to 3:30 p.m.

fields.whoShouldAct: Anyone who was in these places during these times and is not fully vaccinated or has not had measles.
whatToDo: Check your vaccination records. A vaccine given within 72 hours of exposure can help.
If you have symptoms, call before visiting a clinic so staff can protect others.
Stay home from school or work if you develop symptoms.
